independence: Separate run and session from the translator job; this audit re-read every catalogue value from the working tree rather than trusting the translator's summary. Auditor agent name differs from the translator agent name per the programme's independent-auditor rule.
scope: Full first independent audit of the single namespace ui.onboarding.tour for zh-CN: all 123 English, 123 context-sidecar and 123 target values read side by side, plus the tour-copy.ts / tour-steps.ts joins (command-palette shortcut fragments, welcome and chat-input list joins). Catalogue semantics, idiom, register, glossary, spacing and width only; no rendering, browser, build or native-speaker sign-off.
verdict: clean-with-findings: 0 blocker, 0 major. 3 minor (one awkward clause, one calque collocation, one narrowed request) and 6 nits. Translation quality is high: terminology follows the glossary and existing zh-CN catalogues throughout, register is consistently 你, punctuation and quote conventions match the style guide, and no placeholder/ICU/bidi/NFC risk exists because every message is parameterless.

findings.current: 智能体的数量没有上限，尽管按需创建，帮你处理日常事务。
findings.proposed: 智能体的数量没有上限，你可以按需创建，让它们帮你处理日常事务。
findings.reason: 「尽管按需创建」后直接接「帮你处理日常事务」，两个分句的主语从「你」跳到「智能体」，读起来像拼接；补出主语、把目的从句落到智能体上，意思仍是原文的 create as many as you need to handle all your daily tasks。

findings.current: 创建：你也可以创建只在将来某个时间运行一次的任务。 / 配置：你也可以安排只在将来某个时间运行一次的任务。
findings.proposed: 两处统一为「你也可以创建只在将来某个时间运行一次的任务。」
findings.reason: 两句英文完全相同，同一句在导览里出现两种译法（创建 / 安排）；统一动词即可，无需改动第一处。
本命名空间、ui.schedules.* 与侧栏（ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.schedules = 定时任务）都把 schedule 统一为「定时任务」，同一屏的正文还要求点击「创建定时任务」；「周期任务」会让同一步出现两个词。英文 recurring task 与 schedule 的区别在中文里可由「定时任务」一并承担。

findings.reason: 文档内编辑场景中文惯用「行内」，「内联」多用于 CSS/函数；全仓库没有既定译法（英文目录中 inline 0 处），因此属可选润色而非术语违规。

observations.note: Width: every body paragraph is materially narrower than its English source (worst ratio 0.64x English characters: agent_capabilities.body.1, 292 cells vs 457 chars), so no body overflow risk at the 500px tour panel. Label budgets hold: all titles and alts are within about 1.5x; upload_agent_hub_dialog.title is 22 cells vs 19 chars (1.16x) and action.next 下一步 is exactly 1.50x (6 cells vs 4 chars) — the footer button is the only string sitting on the cap and should be seen in a rendered frame.

Quoted UI labels match the shipped zh-CN values: “查看智能体设置” = ui.agents.dialogs.menu.settings; “创建定时任务” = ui.schedules.schedule_form_dialog.create_schedule; “智能体中心” = ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agent_hub; “定时任务” = ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.schedules; “搜索” = ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.search; “推荐” = ui.common.models.model_select.recommended. The kept-English “Automatic” matches the model-select control label that other zh-CN strings also leave in Latin.

Glossary conformance: hosting provider → 模型提供商 (same as ui.common.models.hosting_select.hosting_provider); agent → 智能体; tool → 工具; prompt → 提示词; schedule → 定时任务; credits → 额度; cost → 费用; canvas → 画布; tour → 导览; Recommended → 推荐. Out of scope but worth knowing: an existing string in ui.agents.settings.general renders hosting provider as 托管提供商, so the wider corpus already carries that drift; this candidate follows the dominant 模型提供商 form and is not the source of it.

The English source noun these five values share is display-masked in tool output, so it was verified at byte level against the committed file (5 occurrences of a 9-character English word, and no bracket-marker bytes in the file); the glossary row for that noun fixes its zh-CN rendering as 工作区, which the candidate uses in all five places. No defect.

Typography: fullwidth punctuation throughout prose (，。：；、（）), “ ” quotes only (no straight quotes, no 「」), no ellipsis, no ASCII punctuation adjacent to CJK, no bidi/zero-width controls, NFC-clean. Structural double spaces in the English prose were correctly collapsed (14 English values carry them; 0 remain in the target).

Register: 你 everywhere, 0 occurrences of 您, no 啦/哦/呀 particles, no ！; only one standalone 请 in the whole namespace (ZH-T9). Titles are period-free; bodies keep 。. The informal, verb-forward walkthrough voice of the context sidecar is matched.

review: Terminology and voice are consistent with the programme glossary and the existing zh-CN catalogues; the tour reads like native product copy, not a translation, across all 37 steps. Two figure alt texts are correct descriptions of wordless diagrams (welcome: 带侧栏、消息气泡和输入框的聊天窗口; agent-capabilities: 三个依次相连的智能体工作步骤), neither begins with 图片 or describes a screenshot, matching the sidecar's do-not-say-image note. The close label 关闭导览 is concise (4 characters), says it closes the tour rather than the app, and is the accessible name Shepherd reads. Shortcut paragraphs were judged as joined strings, not fragments: 按下⌘P（Mac）或Ctrl+P（Windows或Linux）即可打开 and 按下⌘K（Mac）或Ctrl+K（Windows或Linux），命令面板会直接以对话为搜索范围打开…而按下⌘⇧P（Mac）或Ctrl+Shift+P（Windows或Linux）则会在应用自身的命令和页面上打开 — the platform qualifiers use fullwidth parentheses with no space before them, exactly as mainland convention wants, and the 或 construction reads naturally. Remaining issues are stylistic: one dangling clause, one calque collocation, one narrowed request, plus six recorded nits.

joined_renders.method: Executed the renderer's own join, not a fragment reading: each tour-copy.ts run is rendered as t(key) for a catalogue key or literal for a code run, and renderRuns concatenates with no separator (source: src/renderer/src/features/onboarding/tour/tour-copy.ts, TOUR_BODIES.pre_command_palette_open_canvas, and tour-steps.ts step id pre-command-palette-open-canvas). Joins executed in a scratch script over the same catalogue bytes; no DOM, browser, build or component render.
joined_renders.step7_paragraph_1: 再快速看看另一个强大功能：命令面板。在应用的任何位置，按下⌘P（Mac）或Ctrl+P（Windows或Linux）即可打开。这是一个可以从应用任意位置唤出的便捷窗口，让你用键盘访问对话、智能体、设置、页面和各项操作等。用这种方式进入应用的各个分区，往往比层层点击菜单更快。输入一个词即可一次搜索全部内容，也可以先输入前缀缩小范围：# 用于对话，@ 用于智能体和团队，, 用于设置，以及> 用于命令和页面。

limitations: Read-only working-tree audit. One read-only `git status` probe at the start confirmed the target file is untracked; no other git commands, and no catalogue, ledger, code or generated-file edits — the only write is this new receipt. No builds, installs, tests, full suites, browser launches or rendered frames (disk resource hold); the joined renders above are string joins of the renderer's run order, not DOM output. No pseudo-localization, native-speaker or design/UX approval is claimed; CJK width conclusions are cell counts (CJK 2 / ASCII 1), not measured glyph widths, and the visual pass remains open. The English source noun discussed in ZH-O4 was verified against the file's bytes because the chat surface masks it.
